purpose: Prospectively validate the previously discovered BROKER_GROSS_HHI_1D H20 rank association using contemporaneously frozen vendor snapshots. This is replication, not a new blinded discovery.

prospective_source_contract.official_update_semantics: Monday-Friday about 18:30 Asia/Taipei; actual availability follows API.
prospective_source_contract.same_day_capture_requirement: A confirmatory source snapshot must be first retrieved on its own event date in Asia/Taipei after 18:30. No next-day or historical backfill may be relabeled prospective.
prospective_source_contract.earliest_feature_use: next TWSE open after event date d
prospective_source_contract.persisted_data: derived non-reconstructive per-stock HHI plus immutable lineage receipt and content hashes
prospective_source_contract.immutable_first_observed_rule: First successful same-day snapshot is canonical. Retries may not overwrite it.

source_capture_feature.branch_set: all observed valid branches with gross > 0

prospective_validation_sample.universe: Frozen date-correct electronics PIT U100 from the Selection Challenge rule, unchanged.
prospective_validation_sample.u100_rule_summary: date-correct electronics members; valid close; >=18 valid turnover observations over latest 20 sessions; LIQ20=median turnover; 20 valid corporate-action-safe daily returns; rank LIQ20 descending then ticker ascending; first 100
prospective_validation_sample.primary_outcome: within-date [0,1] percentile rank of frozen next-open corporate-action-safe H20 simple return
prospective_validation_sample.market_state: frozen S5 classifier; same-date state is absorbed by date intercept; state diagnostics are descriptive only

primary_model.equation: RANK_FWD_H20 = a_d + bB_d*RANK_BROKER_HHI + bM_d*RANK_MOM20 + bR_d*RANK_REV5 + bL_d*RANK_LIQ20 + bF_d*RANK_AGG_FLOW5 + error
primary_model.rank_method: average ties; scale (rank-1)/(n-1); ascending raw value

stopping_and_peeking.first_primary_judgment: Only after the fixed source-capture window ends and every included signal date has either matured H20 or failed a predeclared data-quality gate.
stopping_and_peeking.if_below_minimum: DATA_OR_LINEAGE_INVALID_STOP; do not extend the window based on observed outcomes.

temporal_stability.split: chronological first half vs second half of eligible prospective signal dates
temporal_stability.rule: Both half-sample mean bB values must be positive and have the same sign as the full prospective mean. No split-date search.

requirements: first-half and second-half mean bB are both positive
all source-vintage and PIT lineage gates pass

implementation_dependency.requirement: Before any prospective H20 judge is opened, freeze and validate a forward date-correct electronics mother/U100 lineage adapter implementing the existing Selection Challenge rules without using forward outcomes.
implementation_dependency.existing_live_universe_is_not_authorized: hengce/legacy/live_universe.json uses pins and same-day trade value and therefore is not the frozen U100 rule.
implementation_dependency.source_capture_policy_until_dependency_c: Persist all-stock derived HHI + source hashes now; mother/U100 join remains pending and cannot be called judge-ready.
